## Executed two iterations
Unlike global depth compression or dense ribbon grooming, localized flank smoothing targets the adult folded-wing ridge without adding disconnected primitives. Use original 137851 vertices, 275630 triangles; +Z front, +Y crown. Estimate cross-section centers by median Z within .024 Y of 160 equally spaced Y samples [-1.01,1.01], Gaussian sigma 4; interpolate per vertex. Convert X,Z around local center to polar theta=atan2(X,Z-center) and radius=hypot(X,Z-center). Build 160x240 maximum radius envelope, periodic theta (tile three copies and fill missing cells with nearest valid using scipy distance_transform_edt); Gaussian filter with wrap theta, nearest Y. Interpolate target radius back onto original vertices. Flank mask smoothstep(.24,.78,abs(sin(theta)))*(1-smoothstep(.22,.53,Y))*smoothstep(-.90,-.68,Y). Delta=clip(target-radius,-.16,.16)*flank*mix. Add integrated surface microrelief from deterministic RNG382 160x240 Gaussian-smoothed noise (sigma 2, std normalized, clipped ±2), amplitude times toe and face protection masks. New radius=max(.001,radius+delta+fuzz), preserve original faces. Control sigma(3,7), mix0, clump0; soft sigma(6,12), mix.85, clump.008; buried sigma(9,20), mix1, clump.014. Iteration 2 clean and micro sigma(8,17), mix1, clump0/.002. Recovered original front reference projection U=.56+.46X,V=.51-.46Y; limited to front/head alpha, cream unobserved back and sides, no claim of measured rear texture. V2 tightens head alpha: smoothstep(.37,.67,Z)*smoothstep(.12,.29,Y)*(1-smoothstep(.66,.85,Y)). Actual two small ocular surface displacements amplitude .032 with Gaussian denominator .0042 at X=-.17,+.18,Y=.49, front mask. All five native GLBs exported and reimported; each 137851 vertices, 275630 faces, watertight, 7168680 bytes. Max flank delta .07080 soft and .08377 buried/clean/micro. VTK rendered imported geometry, vertex color and normals at actual 360x360, 0/45/90/135/180 degree Y-up angles, 25 images; both sheets visually inspected. VTK warned no X server but returned real rendered RGB buffers.

## Gate
Control shows adult wing groove. First iteration blurs it but produces pronounced clay-like uneven clumps rather than down. Second removes much of the groove without extra polygons, but smooth flank patches contrast with rough back; residual fine diagonal artifacts (possible local mesh fold; watertight alone does not rule out self-intersection), flat eye/face rim, gray crown projection discontinuity, exposed toes and adult side body remain. All five ART_REJECTED. No mobile WebGL check after art gate; no release. No new neural inference, no scientific claim. Avoid repeating radial smoothing and dense ribbon approaches; explore independent new base and lightweight physically meaningful hair material only after art geometry improves. Main, source concepts, production and deployment untouched.
